title: Rosacea in Dubai: Triggers and Laser Help
h1: Rosacea in Dubai: the triggers to watch and how laser helps
desc: Rosacea triggers in Dubai's climate, from heat and sun to spicy food and skincare, and how laser, skincare and lifestyle calm facial redness. By Skin & Laser.
answer: Rosacea flares are often triggered by heat, sun, humidity changes, hot drinks, spicy food, alcohol, exercise and harsh skincare, many of which are hard to avoid in Dubai. Vascular laser reduces persistent redness and visible vessels (from AED 600 + VAT), while trigger control and gentle skincare help prevent flares.
facts: Hot drinks, spicy food, alcohol, exercise
body:
## Managing heat and sun

- Mineral SPF 50 every day
- Move between outdoor heat and cold air-conditioning gradually
- Cool the face with a mist, not ice
- Exercise in cooler parts of the day

## Skincare that helps

Choose a gentle cleanser, a barrier-repair moisturiser and mineral sunscreen. Avoid alcohol-based toners, strong acids, scrubs and fragrance. Keep a short diary to spot your own triggers.

## Where laser fits

Laser targets the dilated vessels behind persistent redness. It works best alongside trigger control, and some people also need prescription treatment for bumps and flares.
faq: It's a long-term condition that can be controlled well.
Gentle facials can, but strong peels and extraction can trigger flares. Ask us first.
